# Meta-Analysis-of-Freshwater-Beta-Diversity-Change
Data and R scripts supporting a global meta-analysis of directional changes in freshwater β-diversity under anthropogenic impacts.

# Title: Overall Biotic Differentiation Amid Contrasting Freshwater β-Diversity Responses to Human Impacts 

# Author: Vitor M. B. Ferreira

## Repository structure

* `data/`:

  * `Extraction dataset.xlsx`: dataset used in the main analyses. Use this file with `Bootstrap.R` and `Metaregressions.R`.
  * `lnRR_pairs.xlsx`: effect-size dataset generated by `Bootstrap.R`, containing all paired log response ratios (lnRRs).
  * `Coords.xlsx`: geographic-coordinate data used to produce the maps in the figures file.
  * `Titles.xlsx`: titles of the articles included in the meta-analysis.
